tips.text: Use two 15% Potency mods (Immuno Shield, Instant Secure) once you have found the Antivirus; it usually finishes in two to four stabs.
Leave the mission after a correct stab; the progress banks, but extract first if a Quick Correct Heartcell dropped.
Hunt solo or with a friend, then take the Concert into a public squad; each extra Coda beaten pays everyone one Heartcell.
Bring Revenant or Nyx to the stadium fight; Valkyr and Dante also get named.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin skips shields and kills Gauss-style shield frames.
Rush Exterminates with a fast-killing frame; Duets appear on a timer about three to five minutes in.
Slot Quick Correct only for the final stab when you are within 25% of full; its 10% disinfection costs extra missions earlier.
Size your Potency mods so a stab lands on or past 100%; stopping at 95% leaves you waiting for another Duet.
Mercy a Duet within about ten seconds of downing both; one that stands back up three times flees.
Restart the Concert if a band member spawns invisible and the frontman keeps regenerating.
Watch Eleanor's rotation posts for a 55 to 60% Synapse before farming extra Heartcells.
Players call Coda hunts the least painful adversary system; one cleared every Coda weapon in about eight hours.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing.
